convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for MultiTrend_Signal_KVN custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution, position sizing, and order management logic.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for calculation
derived_values.used_by: BarsCalculated check and bar sufficiency check

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade timing

other_exits: Opposite signal from MultiTrend_Signal_KVN triggers close of existing position when BuyPosClose/SellPosClose permissions are enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot size (absolute value), positive values represent share of deposit in a deal. Handled entirely by TradeAlgorithms.mqh BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions.

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic scans historical bars backward from SignalBar+1 to find the LastTrend direction (+1 for last buy signal, -1 for last sell signal). Long entry only occurs if LastTrend was -1 (opposite side), and short entry only if LastTrend was +1. This prevents entering on the same side as the prevailing trend direction already established. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans act as permission gates. SignalBar=0 allows intrabar signal checking without waiting for new bar; otherwise new bar guard applies. The UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime variables are used as timing references passed to the trade functions.
python_conversion_notes: The MultiTrend_Signal_KVN custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python since it uses iCustom with 4 parameters (K, Kstop, Kperiod, PerADX). The indicator appears to be a trend-filtering signal using ADX (PerADX=14) and some K-based channel/period logic. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all trade execution including the conditional MM sizing (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction), SL/TP placement, and deviation handling - these must be reimplemented. The LastTrend scanning logic (iterating backward from SignalBar+1 to find the most recent signal direction) must be preserved exactly. SignalBar parameter controls whether signals are evaluated on the current forming bar (0) or the last closed bar (1); for backtesting, SignalBar=1 should be used to avoid look-ahead bias.
